description: Validate and apply a trusted local .gitferry bundle: replay commits, restore staged/unstaged changes, and write untracked or snapshot files. Modifies the target unless dryRun=true. Preview first and review conflicts afterward. force bypasses repository, dirty-tree, and overwrite guards.

bundlePath.description: Absolute path to the .gitferry bundle file

cwd.description: Absolute path to the target git repository

dryRun.description: Validate and report the plan without changing anything (default false)

force.description: Override repo-fingerprint, dirty-tree, and file-overwrite guards (default false)

includeUntracked.description: Write untracked files from the bundle (default true)

name: apply_bundle
title: Apply a local GitFerry bundle
